name: docs-kit
description: Two layers in one plugin. Docs: scaffold a three-layer structure (docs-init), reconcile it with what a session actually did (docs-sync), validate it deterministically (docs-check), render an HTML read model (docs-render), and turn settled decisions into a delegation prompt (brief). Crew: run tickets in parallel over a fixed pool of executor worktrees — one ticket, one branch, one named session — and close them out from the commit trailer (crew-init, crew-status). Four warn-only hooks watch Architecture edits, undocumented code changes, resource locks and unexplained questions.
